title: Charlie Munger & The Psychology of Human Misjudgment
summary:
One of the best ways to behave more rationally is to understanding our own shortcomings biologically which we are oftentimes unaware of. This episode dives deep into these shortcomings, and how we can sidestep them to invest more wisely. IN THIS EPISODE YOU’LL LEARN: 

 0:00 - Intro

 4:11 - Many of the human misjudgments that Charlie Munger has spoken about extensively.
